snippet:
**Note:** ChatGPT can only access data and perform actions that your Pipedrive user account is authorized to access. Permissions are inherited from your existing Pipedrive role and visibility settings. You **must** have a Pro, Business, Enterprise or Edu ChatGPT plan to connect the Pipedrive MCP.
You can connect the Pipedrive MCP server to ChatGPT to allow your AI assistant to securely access and interact with your Pipedrive data.

Once developer mode is enabled, go to **”Plugins”** on the left-hand side of the screen and click ****”+”**** to create a new plugin.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/mcp%20chatgpt%204.png)
Enter Pipedrive MCP as the app name and in the **”Connection”** field enter [https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp](https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp). Then, click **”Create”**.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/mcp%20chatgpt%205-1.png)
After creating the app, you’ll be redirected to Pipedrive to complete the installation.

Before starting your conversation, add the plugin **”Pipedrive MCP”** to the conversation.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/mcp%20chatgpt%208-1.png)
Your AI assistant can now access Pipedrive data and perform supported actions based on the permissions granted to your account.

title: Pipedrive MCP Server | Connect Claude & ChatGPT to Your CRM
snippet:
Empower AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to securely and reliably work with your Pipedrive data. Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.
Pipedrive is an official connector in Claude and ChatGPT. Find it in the connector directory and connect your account. No manual server setup required.

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants securely connect to external tools and data sources. With Pipedrive MCP, your AI assistant can securely access and act on your CRM data using natural language.
**Step 1: Connect securely**
Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes via a secure OAuth login. No coding, APIs, middleware or developer support required.
**Step 2: Ask your AI to act**
Simply tell ChatGPT or Claude what you want to do, using plain language directly from its input box.
**Step 3: Get instant results**
Your AI assistant can find information, update records, create activities and automate workflows using live Pipedrive data.

MCP gives your AI assistant access to Pipedrive. Skills are ready-made instructions that show Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools how to handle everyday sales tasks, using your live Pipedrive data. Skills handle the busywork behind a good sales week: where to focus, what’s slipping and whether you’re on track. Every rep starts each day knowing what matters, not digging for it.

## Your AI assistant gets access. You stay in control.
An official, reliable and fully supported connection built and maintained by Pipedrive.

##### Secure by design
Your AI assistant can only work with information Pipedrive users already have permission to see/edit.
##### Fast and easy setup
Connect in minutes through secure OAuth. No coding, no API development, no developer required.
##### Live CRM data
Your AI assistant works with real-time CRM data, not delayed syncs or outdated information.

title: Pipedrive launches native MCP server, bringing CRM workflows directly into AI assistants
snippet:
New York, June 30, 2026 – [Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/), the easy and intelligent CRM for small and medium-sized businesses, today announced the launch of its native [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/features/mcp-server) server, enabling customers to securely connect Pipedrive with AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP-compatible tools.
MCP is an open standard that enables AI assistants to securely connect to external tools and data sources. Through Pipedrive’s native MCP server, AI assistants can interact with live CRM data in real time while respecting existing user permissions and maintaining a full audit trail of actions performed.
Using the Pipedrive MCP server, customers can:
- Search deals, contacts, organizations and leads using natural language
- Create and update CRM records without manual data entry
- Convert leads into deals and manage activities
- Generate pipeline insights and sales analysis
- Turn meeting notes into structured CRM records
- Automate follow-up actions and multi-step sales workflows
- Execute other intelligent automations and continuously evolving AI capabilities

useful,” said Joe Futty, Chief Product & Technology Officer at Pipedrive. “With Pipedrive MCP, we’re giving customers direct, secure access to their sales data and workflows wherever work happens. This is an important step toward a future where Pipedrive's intelligence isn’t confined to a single interface, it’s embedded in every tool, every conversation and every decision a sales team makes."

Unlike custom API integrations or unofficial third-party connectors, Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive, requires no coding, and works with real-time CRM data. Every action performed through an AI assistant follows the user’s existing permissions and is recorded in Pipedrive’s change logs for full transparency and accountability.

Pipedrive MCP is available to customers on all Pipedrive plans. The server works with any AI assistant that supports custom MCP connections, including ChatGPT and Claude, with setup completed through a secure OAuth connection and no developer resources required.

title: Pipedrive MCP server review: official URL and setup for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
snippet:
# Pipedrive MCP server
Yes. Pipedrive publishes an official MCP server at https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp. It's hosted and lets you sign in with your Pipedrive account. It offers 37 tools. We last checked it on 9 Nov 2026.
Official: answers MCP requests at mcp.pipedrive.ai. Checked 9 Nov 2026. Maintained by [Stuart Brameld](https://martechdb.com/methodology#who).

### Does Pipedrive have an official MCP server?
Yes. Pipedrive publishes its MCP server itself. Its address is on Pipedrive's own domain (mcp.pipedrive.ai). MartechDB only lists servers a vendor publishes, never community copies.
### What is the Pipedrive MCP server URL?
The address is https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp.
### Does the Pipedrive MCP server need an API key?

In Claude, add https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp as a custom connector (Customize, Connectors, Add custom connector). In ChatGPT, turn on developer mode (Settings, Apps, Advanced settings) and create an app with the same address. In Cursor, use the Add to Cursor link on MartechDB's page, or paste the JSON settings into your mcp.json. In Claude Code, run: claude mcp add --transport http pipedrive https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp
### What can the Pipedrive MCP server do?
It offers 37 tools, including getActivities, getActivity, addActivity, updateActivity and getDeals (as its documentation names them, read on 2 Oct 2026).

In CRM, the most agent-friendly alternatives with an official MCP server are Attio (97/100), Zero (97/100), NetHunt (95/100), Twenty (94/100) and Breakcold (92/100). Pipedrive scores 96/100 on the same index.

## Connect your AI to MartechDB
Then ask it about Pipedrive, or any of the 1,737 marketing tools with an official MCP server. Free, no sign-in.

title: Pipedrive MCP tools - Knowledge Base | Pipedrive
snippet:
In MCP, **tools** are the actions that an AI assistant can perform in Pipedrive. Each tool is designed for a specific task, such as creating a deal, retrieving a contact's details or updating an activity.
When an AI assistant connects to Pipedrive through MCP, it can use these tools to access information and perform actions on your behalf, based on the permissions you grant.
Tool names follow a consistent naming pattern:
| getX (plural) | Fetch a list |
|---|---|
| getX (singular) | Fetch one specific record |
| addX | Create a new record |
| updateX | Edit an existing record |
| searchX | Find records by keyword or criteria |

**Use case** |
|---|---|---|
| getActivities | Fetch a list of activities | "Show me all calls scheduled this week" |
| getActivity | Fetch one specific activity | "Get details of this particular meeting" |
| addActivity | Create a new activity | "Schedule a follow-up call with this contact" |
| updateActivity | Edit an existing activity | "Mark this call as done" or "Reschedule it" |

title: Pipedrive MCP for Claude - Knowledge Base | Pipedrive
snippet:
**Note:** Claude can only access data and perform actions that your Pipedrive user account is authorized to access. Permissions are inherited from your existing Pipedrive role and visibility settings.
You can connect the Pipedrive MCP server to Claude to allow your AI assistant to securely access and interact with your Pipedrive data.
---
## Enable the Pipedrive MCP connector
**Note:** Before you begin, make sure that you have a Pipedrive account and have permissions to install and use connectors in Claude.
To enable the Pipedrive MCP connector for Claude go to **“Customize”** and select **“Connectors”.**
Then, click on the **“+”** icon and select “**Add custom connector”**.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/claude%20mcp%201.png)
Click **”****Connect****”.** Enter Pipedrive MCP as the app name and in the **”Connection”** field, enter [https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp](https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp)and click **”Add”***.*
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/claude%20mcp%202-1.png)
**Note:** If it’s the first time you’re connecting Pipedrive to Claude, you may be prompted to sign in to your Pipedrive account and authorize access.
Review the requested permissions in the Pipedrive pop-up and click **”Allow and install”** to complete the installation process.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/claude%20mcp%203.png)
Once the installation is complete, Claude will be authorized to access your Pipedrive account in accordance with your existing user permissions.
---
## Use Pipedrive MCP in Claude
Once the connector is enabled, you can start using Pipedrive MCP in your conversations with Claude.
Before starting a conversation, open a new chat and verify that **Pipedrive MCP** is enabled and available.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/claude%20mcp%204.png)
Your AI assistant can now securely access Pipedrive data and perform supported actions based on the permissions granted to your account.
**Note:** By default, Claude may not load all available MCP tools when starting a conversation. If you need access to all Pipedrive MCP tools, enable the setting that loads all available tools in the connector configuration.
